title: AQARION ClaimLock Disposition
description: Canonical disposition vocabulary for AQARION research claims. Evidence class is a separate semantic field.

oneOf.description: The specified artifact or version is locked for audit. FROZEN does not imply mathematical proof.
A declared evidence or governance gate prevents promotion or publication.
Evidence is retained but excluded from promotion pending resolution.
The artifact or representation is obsolete and retained for provenance.
The claim or artifact has been replaced by a successor.
The result has been withdrawn because it should no longer be relied upon as stated.
A counterexample or contradiction establishes that the stated claim is false.
